summary: Ingredion Inc filed an 8-K reporting its agreement to acquire Tate & Lyle PLC via a recommended cash offer. Under the scheme of arrangement, Tate & Lyle shareholders will receive 595 pence per share, valuing the deal at approximately £2.7 billion (~$3.6 billion). The boards of both companies reached agreement; Tate & Lyle shareholders may also receive permitted dividends of up to 20 pence total. The transaction will be implemented through a UK court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement, with the option for a takeover offer. Completion is subject to regulatory approvals and shareholder votes; risk-arb watchers should monitor UK Code timeline and antitrust clearance.
